topPRs.title: fix(ops): surface forbidden L1 RPC responses
topPRs.author: arunimshukla
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- stop L1 RPC URL discovery when an endpoint returns HTTP 403
- replace the misleading chain ID mismatch warning with a validation failure warning
- add regression coverage for forbidden responses and legitimate chain ID fallback

## Rationale

A 403 response does not contain a chain ID. The existing code labels every validation error as a chain ID mismatch and continues to another URL, which can mask an authentication or access-control failure.

The new behaviour returns the wrapped HTTP error immediately while preserving fallback for an actual chain ID mismatch.

Closes #1016.

## Validation

- `go test ./internal/config -count=1`
- `go test -race ./internal/config -run 'TestFindValidL1URL' -count=1`
- `go vet ./internal/config`
- `git diff --check`

topPRs.title: fix(config): add schemes to Radius RPC URLs
topPRs.author: arunimshukla
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- add HTTPS schemes to the Radius public and sequencer RPC URLs
- synchronise the corresponding entries in `chainList.json`, `chainList.toml` and `CHAINS.md`

## Rationale

The existing values are bare hostnames rather than absolute URIs. Consumers that require a URI scheme cannot parse them as RPC endpoints.

Closes #1083.

## Validation

- confirmed both source values parse as HTTPS URIs with non-empty hosts
- confirmed the generated JSON and TOML chain-list entries match the source configuration
- `python -m json.tool chainList.json`
- `git diff --check`

## Endpoint status

Both HTTPS hosts completed URI and TLS resolution during validation but returned an upstream 502 response to `eth_chainId`. This PR corrects the registry URI syntax only; it does not claim that the Radius endpoints are currently operational.
